articles.excerpt: Family-friendly video games are often overlooked in favor of chaotic shooters, mature RPGs, or complex strategy games. That’s a bit of a shame, as there are dozens of incredible titles out there that carry a rating suitable for even the youngest gamer in your family. Game Pass has unsurprisingly become a haven for these sorts of adventures, with hits like Banjo-Kazooie, Minecraft, and Overcooked 2 gracing its catalog. articles.dek: Rockstar's open-world franchise returns this month.
articles.excerpt: Grand Theft Auto is one of the most popular and best-known franchises in gaming and expectations are high for the next entry in the series. The first GTA 6 trailer was released in December 2023 and the second arrived in May 2025 following the game's delay to May 2026. The game was delayed again and is now set for release in November 2026. As rumored, the game returns to Vice City. articles.title: Best GBA Games: Top 30 Game Boy Advance Titles
articles.dek: The Game Boy Advance is arguably Nintendo's best handheld and featured a startling number of great games.
articles.excerpt: By the time the Game Boy Advance dropped in the early 2000s, Nintendo had already nailed the handheld formula. The strategy was simple but effective: pack serious power into a sleek design, then keep the hits coming with a steady flow of great games. Unsurprisingly, it was a massive hit.
